result.title: LabWorld: Learning Interactive 4D Worlds for Scientific Experimentation
result.comment: 20 pages, 4 figures. Suozhi Huang and Kelsey Fu contributed equally
result.summary: Autonomous scientific agents must not only reason about experiments but also interact with the physical environments in which they are executed. Existing laboratory simulators typically rely on manually constructed assets and predefined procedures, while laboratory videos capture real equipment, layouts, and interactions but leave this information implicit in pixels. We introduce LabWorld, an agent-driven Real2Sim framework for reconstructing interactive 4D laboratory worlds from monocular RGB video. LabWorld recovers reusable 3D assets, a metric scene, time-varying object states, and procedure events. Multi-frame observations provide complementary evidence for asset and scene reconstruction, while motion reconstruction combines visual and geometric observations with event constraints encoding the spatial and temporal requirements of laboratory interactions. We evaluate LabWorld on real pipetting and vortexing videos collected in our laboratory against general-purpose agentic and dedicated reconstruction baselines. For pipetting, LabWorld achieves a mean Mask IoU of 0.501, exceeding the strongest baseline by 0.033. For vortexing, it achieves a mean Tube-Length-Normalized PCK-AUC of 0.638, exceeding the strongest baseline by 0.035. On five pipetting videos, event-conditioned reconstruction increases the fraction of modeled physical constraints satisfied from 14.3% (5/35) to 100% (35/35). The resulting worlds expose geometry, motion, articulation, and events as explicit, editable state for replay, inspection, and future embodied scientific systems.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LabWorld，一个 agent 驱动的 Real2Sim 框架，从单目 RGB 视频重建可交互的 4D 实验室世界，恢复可复用 3D 资产、度量场景、时变物体状态与操作事件，并以多帧视觉几何证据加事件约束改善重建。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文把操作过程表示为显式、可编辑的状态与事件约束，并统计物理约束满足比例，可能为「内部状态是否保留任务必要证据」提供对照思路与约束满足式评价线索；但其关注外部世界重建而非 VLM 推理状态，联系需核查。
